whatsappMessage:
Hi Kushum Hotel and Restaurant Team,

I noticed your restaurant has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Nohsa, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special menu showcase, aur AIIMS Patna Road location map integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/kushum

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Kushum Hotel and Restaurant Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Kushum Hotel and Restaurant) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and menu showcase for your location near AIIMS Patna Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
